Local OCR assets: Tesseract.js 7.0.0; tesseract.js-core 7.0.0; English tessdata_fast from the installed tesseract-ocr-eng package. Apache-2.0 licenses and third-party notices are included. The .wasm.js core files embed WebAssembly and do not need separate .wasm downloads. Only LSTM engine mode 1 is used. All asset URLs are set to this local directory. No remote models or processing services are used.
